messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: metering-usage-pipeline-high-lag fired (INC-2026-0348). Priority: P1. Trigger: consumer-lag > 10m for shard group 12. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026-0348
pd-bot: PD alert routed to #incidents -> oncall: @sre_oncall_jamie. Escalation policy: immediate. PagerDuty escalation step 1 initiated.
sre_oncall_jamie: acking oncall. I'm looking. Starting checks: consumer lag, DLQ rate, checkpoint offsets.
eng_runtime_ana: on it too — seeing elevated token delta logs from the aggregator: `token_count_delta > expected by ~55k/min` across 3 partitions. Posting quick grep: `grep "token_delta" /var/log/agg/2026-03-14.log | tail -n 50`
infra_rohan: infra side: autoscaler reports repeated scale failures on metering-consumer-prod due to ephemeral pool exhaustion. 5/6 scale attempts failed with OOM on shard 12 worker.
billing_chris: flagged — if token count doesn't reconcile we risk invoice mismatch for yesterday's billing window. Which customers? top-affected accounts: corp-omega, retail-x, partner-beta. Potential invoice hold if we can't reconcile by EOD PST.
emma_support: pinging customer success for the three accounts now. Triage: are they already seeing throttled requests? Any outbound errors?
sre_oncall_jamie: logs show consumer offset lag increased at 13:07 UTC. DLQ rate up 30x. Trying a consumer restart on shard 12 to drain backlog. Command I'm running: ```kubectl -n metering rollout restart deployment/metering-consumer-shard-12```
eng_runtime_ana: +1 on restart but also we'll temporarily disable KV-prefix caching for shard 12 to reduce memory churn — guidance: change config `METERING_CACHE_ENABLED=false` and restart. Doing canary.
pd-bot: PD note: INC-2026-0348 -> acknowledged by jamie at 13:17 UTC. Escalation paused.
infra_rohan: restart initiated. Node metrics show memory pressure easing slightly. Restart logs: `consumer[12] init ok`, but processing backpressure still present.
sre_oncall_jamie: consumer restart helped but not fully drained — backlog at ~4.2M messages. Throughput limited by a single slow downstream write. Investigating which downstream.
eng_runtime_ana: found slow write to ledger-writer-db7 (write latency 2.4s). Writes are getting retried and causing throughput collapse. Raising a ticket to DB infra. `/ping db7` shows elevated iowait.
infra_rohan: DB infra says they are seeing increased compaction and IO storms, will reprovision IO bursts. ETA 25m. Meanwhile suggest throttling ingestion to preserve headroom.
billing_chris: we need a mitigation plan to avoid invoice blockers: 1) stop new ingestion for non-critical customers (rate-limit), 2) mirror backlog to cold storage for later replay, 3) prepare manual token reconciliation to avoid invoice holds. Which is fastest?
sre_oncall_jamie: implement temporary rate-limit rule for public API keys without active billing windows. Pushing a filter rule: `if customer not in [corp-omega, retail-x, partner-beta] => throttle 50%`. Pushing config now.
eng_runtime_ana: started mirroring backlog to S3 (prefix s3://metering-backups/2026-03-14/shard-12/) — copy process running, ETA 18m. This will let us delete and replay later without losing tokens.
emma_support: CS confirmed corp-omega saw delayed invoice generation for last cycle. They've put temporary internal invoice hold flags — will await reconciliation plan. Keeping them updated.
sre_oncall_jamie: PD: changing status to "mitigating". Root cause hypothesis: IO storm on ledger DB causing downstream write retries -> consumer backlog -> token delta inflation as partial retries double-count tokens in the short window. Need coordinated correction.
pd-bot: PD note: steps logged, no escalation triggered.
eng_runtime_ana: quick detection rule: mark suspect token deltas where `retry_count > 1 && write_status != success` and emit a tombstone for duplicate token increments during replay. We'll prepare a patch to deduplicate by (customer_id, event_id) on replay.
billing_chris: good — also need a manual stopgap: run an aggregate reconciliation job against raw events for the affected billing window to produce corrected token counts. I can author the SQL, but will need runtime access.
infra_rohan: DB infra completed IO scaling. Ledger-writer-db7 latencies dropping back to normal. Consumer throughput recovering; backlog draining rate now 3x previous.
sre_oncall_jamie: backlog down to 1.1M. Mirroring to S3 at 65% done. Throttles in place. No new customer errors reported after throttle.
eng_runtime_ana: deploying dedupe/replay job to a sandbox namespace for validation. Command: ```kubectl -n metering run replay-dedupe --image=redwood/metering-replay:canary --env-file=dedupe.env```
billing_chris: prepping reconciliation SQL: will join events_shard_12_raw -> deduped_events to compute final token counts. Draft ready, will run once validation complete.
emma_support: updating impacted customers: corp-omega (PM notified), retail-x (ops notified), partner-beta (account lead notified). ETA message: will provide reconciliation status in 2h.
sre_oncall_jamie: handoff plan: I'll stay on for 45 more minutes to ensure replay is validated. After that, @next_oncall_maya will take over. Adding runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/metering-backlog-playbook
next_oncall_maya: acked for handoff at 14:02 UTC. I'll pick up and monitor until cleared.
eng_runtime_ana: replay validation passed basic dedupe checks on 1000 events sample. Scheduling full replay from s3 backup in 40m.
billing_chris: once replay completes, I'll run reconciliation and sign off on corrected token counts. If successful, we'll lift invoice holds and trigger invoice regen for the three customers.
emma_support: noted. I'll prepare customer comms template to explain a delayed invoice regen and apologize for disruption.
sre_oncall_jamie: PD: setting incident notes and tagging for postmortem. Root cause candidates: DB IO compaction timing + lack of durable dedupe on retries. Postmortem owners: eng_runtime_ana, infra_rohan, billing_chris.
pd-bot: Incident INC-2026-0348 status updated: mitigating -> monitoring at 14:22 UTC. PagerDuty will remain open until reconciliation finish.
eng_runtime_ana: final status update before handoff: backlog drained to 120k, replay staging done, dedupe job ready. Next steps for @next_oncall_maya: watch replay, run reconciliation SQL, confirm invoice regen.
next_oncall_maya: taking over. Thanks @jamie. If anything flares, page me and I'll escalate.
emma_support: I'll send interim customer updates now.
sre_oncall_jamie: leaving channel for handoff at 14:30 UTC (log out). Thanks team. (reaction :thumbsup:)
